findings: The openapi-rest-route-parity kernel (oya-check-openapi-rest-route-parity) already existed with full unit test coverage. The remaining integration gap was end-to-end CLI coverage proving the validator catches drift in both directions between _ROUTE constants and OpenAPI paths. Adding 3 integration tests is the minimum honest diff.

Synthetic violation: REST crate declares /ops/api/v1/health + /ops/api/v1/orders but OpenAPI contract only declares /ops/api/v1/health. The validator must exit 1 and print 'openapi-rest-route-parity validation failed' + '/ops/api/v1/orders' to stderr.

Opposite synthetic violation: OpenAPI declares /ops/api/v1/orders but the REST crate omits it. The validator must exit 1 and print 'openapi-rest-route-parity validation failed' + '/ops/api/v1/orders' to stderr.
Clean path: REST crate and OpenAPI contract both declare /ops/api/v1/health. Gate must exit 0 and print 'openapi-rest-route-parity validation passed'.
No new crates, no new workspace deps, no serde. Constraint honored. No YAML workflow changes per OP-11.
